title: 13 Best Herbal Teas For Dizziness
description: Centella asiatica teas, also known as Gotu Kola, have been traditionally used to treat dizziness due to their adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory properties. This herbal preparation helps to alleviate dizziness by improving blood circulation, reducing oxidative stress, and stabilizing the nervous system.
